description: This Java class defines a simple LogNode filter named MessageOnlyLogFilter that implements the LogNode interface. Its purpose is to filter log messages to pass only the message content, omitting metadata like tags and priorities. The class supports chaining via the 'next' LogNode, allowing it to be integrated into a logging pipeline.

classes.description: A filter class implementing LogNode that outputs only the log message content, suitable for simplified log views.
